record_layout: x (32 B, full P-256 coordinate) + (a,b) coefficient pair (32 B packed) + 8 B tag/owner word
why_sparse: dense records at S = 2^127.63 steps would need 2^61.17 B against the 2^73 B cap, so the sparse DP predicate is a DESIGN NECESSITY, not a saving; the dense every-step configuration is the census instrument only, and arm B measures the sparse pipeline.
